01 / A PLACE TO STOP

The complete decision map.

The film compresses. This map keeps the choices visible.
Select any choice for its recorded reason and source.

Core retains; TypeScript interprets.

Source bytes, revision and project transactions, six cache handles, and request/session retention move to core. Language algorithms stay in TypeScript. Selection and failure boundaries are preserved.

Follow this boundary ↘
The CLI supplies a host module.

Syntax and canonical paths belong to CLI. Daemon loads the supplied executor URL and moves ordered bytes. Renderer formats lifecycle reports; telemetry keeps usage. Node-free declarations still lead to a Node runtime.

Follow this boundary ↘
Identity crosses every boundary.

CommandName travels beside argv; protocol generation advances to 5. Closed failure vocabularies and ordered guards own retry meaning: authenticate → ready → memory → queue → duplicate.

Follow this boundary ↘
Accepted work stays accepted.

Codec, validator, socket directions, lifecycle, execution, receiver and capture split apart. FIFO accepts once. Duplicate requests attach. Fetch and reattachment have independent budgets; append precedes offset advancement.

Follow this boundary ↘
Policy owns limits; sessions own lifetimes.

One daemon snapshot covers output, memory, retries, polling, diagnostics and deadlines. No user threshold knobs. Worker generations, sampled activity, clocks, registry identity and delivery barriers have explicit owners. Host-side policy is separate.

Follow this boundary ↘
A staged move becomes active.

#148 creates package machinery and freezes CLI copies; #149 switches the CLI and removes them. Public testing becomes read-only; compiler inventories enforce the boundary. Test and scope changes, plus eight deferred behaviors, belong in the review.

DEFERRED CHOICE	AT THIS STACK’S TIP	SEPARATE FOLLOW-UP PROPOSES
Ledger eviction	Acknowledged requests still remain in the daemon-lifetime ledger.	Remove acknowledged entries and expire unacknowledged ones after completion.
Startup silence bound	A live silent startup has no silence deadline.	Add a six-hour silence bound; healthy progress still has no overall deadline.
Control-plane readiness	Explicit start still uses a queued readiness execution.	Report readiness from the control plane without waiting behind navigation.
Endpoints under state directory	Endpoint placement remains the existing platform-specific scheme.	Move endpoint ownership under state-directory identity and removal semantics.
Selection-aware byte retention	A selected snapshot drops omitted cached source bytes.	Retain omitted sibling bytes until the next authoritative workspace refresh.
Readiness-armed idle	Idle accounting begins when lifetime is constructed.	Start the idle interval only after warm-up and ready publication.
Completion-based idle	Navigation acceptance resets the idle deadline.	Reset it at navigation completion instead.
Socket-bind election evaluation	File-lease startup election remains.	Evaluate using endpoint bind ownership; adopt only if existing guarantees hold.
